name: dsh-workspace-migrate
description: DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin: move a workspace to a new path without stopping DSH — moves the project directory, relocates every session (including running ones and the conversation you are in) by rebinding its live writer, rewrites the session header cwd frame-safely, and updates the workspace registry. Ships a sidebar entry, a per-conversation entry, a Settings page, and the workspace_migrate tool.

scripts.test: node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check lib/dsh-workspace-migrate.mjs && node --check lib/live-move.mjs && node test/hosttest.mjs && node test/clienttest.mjs && node test/livetest.mjs && node test/selftest.mjs
